payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP over positions in s with a 2D state: ans[i][0] for best up to i without necessarily ending a t at i, ans[i][1] for best with a t ending at i. Inner loop over match length j checks valid placements.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a 2D DP array ans with two values per index, and iterates over possible t-ending positions and match lengths, typical of dp_2d_state for string matching with wildcards.
